title: Groundbreaking biblical archaeology discovery 'proves' Jesus existed
description: The Tel Dan inscription, or "House of David" inscription, was unearthed in 1993 at Tel Dan in northern Israel — and is considered among the most significant biblical archaeology discoveries ever made

title: The sunhat is everywhere in Athens as crowds grow larger at ancient sites
description: Athens sees a surge in hat sales due to record tourism numbers. Tourists seek protection from the relentless midday heat outside the Acropolis. Many visitors spend hours in high temperatures with limited shade available. Health campaigners welcome increased awareness of sun exposure dangers. Hatmakers report a shift in public attitudes towards wearing hats.
